description: GlobaLens dependency updates (P1 task 5, docs/adr/0011-ci-toolchain.md). Every update waits 7 days after its release, like pnpm's minimumReleaseAge (ADR-0001), and arrives in weekly groups. Nothing merges by itself: the owner merges every pull request.

packageRules.description: npm waits 7 days, like pnpm's minimumReleaseAge in pnpm-workspace.yaml.
PyPI waits 7 days. uv's exclude-newer in pyproject.toml is a fixed date, so a PyPI update newer than it needs that date moved in the same pull request (ADR-0011).
The SHA-pinned actions wait 7 days after the release their new commit belongs to.
One weekly pull request for the actions.
One weekly pull request for the tools pinned in the workflows (zizmor, OSV-Scanner).
One weekly pull request for npm minor and patch updates.
One weekly pull request for PyPI minor and patch updates in the uv workspace.
pnpm is pinned twice (mise.toml and packageManager in package.json): they move together.
Node.js is pinned in mise.toml and bounded by engines in package.json: they move together.
mise runs CI and the devcontainer at one version (a test keeps them equal): they move together.

customManagers.description: Tool versions in workflow env, each under a `# renovate:` comment (MISE_VERSION, ZIZMOR_VERSION, OSV_SCANNER_VERSION).
The PostgreSQL image of the SQL tests (ADR-0007), pinned by tag and digest in a Python file.
